title: Manns Search For Meenie 25
author: bpatrick
body: Man, this shit’s action packed! Shots be poppin’ off like crazy, son! And you guys thought it was going to be all sex. I guess you’re pretty disappointed. When we see how this little scene turns out I think I’m going to put Mann on hold for a while. So far it looks like Vivian Blank’s up next with one vote. Any other suggestions, let me know.

comments.author: Och
comments.text: I’m pretty thrilled about more Vivian Blank as well!

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.text: Yay! I better get on it then. I’m thinking this segment of MSFM only has a page or two left.
